activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
Preparing and eating breakfast, making tea with kettle and toaster
Changing into work clothes and checking shift notes on phone
Commuting to the hospital for the morning shift
Working as a health care professional: patient assessments, medication rounds and clinical documentation
Taking a short lunch break in the staff room
Continuing clinical duties: patient care, coordinating with colleagues and updating care records
Clearing the table and washing dishes
Taking a shower and washing up after work
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and browsing on the computer
Night routine: setting out clothes for tomorrow and dimming the desk lamp
